settings.name: ANTIBOT_URI
settings.description: **Challenge URL:** The URL where users will be redirected to complete the challenge. Make sure this URL is not used for anything else on your site.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_TIME_RESOLVE
settings.description: **Challenge Time Limit:** The maximum time (in seconds) a user has to complete the challenge. After this time, a new challenge will be generated. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_TIME_VALID
settings.description: **Challenge Validity:** How long (in seconds) a completed challenge is valid. After this time, users will have to solve a new challenge. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_SUCCESS_URI
settings.description: **Success Redirect URL:** A fixed URL to redirect users to after they successfully solve the challenge, instead of the page they originally requested. Leave empty to return users to their original destination.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_IGNORE_URI
settings.description: **Excluded URLs:** List of URI regex patterns separated by spaces that should bypass the challenge. Patterns are checked against the path and the full request URI with query string.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_IGNORE_IP
settings.description: **Excluded IPs:** List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges separated by spaces that should bypass the challenge.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_IGNORE_RDNS
settings.description: **Excluded Reverse DNS:** List of reverse DNS suffixes separated by spaces that should bypass the challenge.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RDNS_GLOBAL
settings.description: **Global IPs Only:** If set to `yes`, only perform reverse DNS checks on public IP addresses.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_IGNORE_ASN
settings.description: **Excluded ASNs:** List of ASN numbers separated by spaces that should bypass the challenge.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_IGNORE_USER_AGENT
settings.description: **Excluded User Agents:** List of User-Agent regex patterns separated by spaces that should bypass the challenge.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_IGNORE_HEADER_NAME
settings.description: **Header name:** Name of a request header that makes the request bypass the antibot challenge. Numbered pairs: `_NAME_1` goes with `_VALUE_1`.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_IGNORE_HEADER_VALUE
settings.description: **Header value:** PCRE regex the header value must match. Leave empty to match on the header being present, whatever it carries.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_IGNORE_COUNTRY
settings.description: **Excluded Countries:** List of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes separated by spaces that should bypass the challenge.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_ONLY_COUNTRY
settings.description: **Only Challenge Countries:** List of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes that must solve the challenge. All other countries are skipped.

settings.name: USE_ANTIBOT
settings.description: **Enable Antibot:** Set to `cookie` to enable the Cookie challenge.

variants.description: **Enable Antibot:** Set to `cookie` to enable the Cookie challenge.
**Enable Antibot:** Set to `javascript` to enable the JavaScript challenge.
**Enable Antibot:** Set to `captcha` to enable the Captcha challenge.
Enable antibot; set to `recaptcha` to enable reCAPTCHA.
**Enable Antibot:** Set to `hcaptcha` to enable the hCaptcha challenge.
**Enable Antibot:** Set to `turnstile` to enable the Turnstile challenge.
**Enable Antibot:** Set to `mcaptcha` to enable the mCaptcha challenge.
**Enable Antibot:** Set to `capjs` to enable the Cap.js challenge.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_JAVASCRIPT_DIFFICULTY
settings.description: **JavaScript difficulty:** Proof-of-work difficulty in leading zero bits (16 to 28).

settings.name: ANTIBOT_CAPTCHA_ALPHABET
settings.description: **Captcha Alphabet:** A string of characters to use for generating the CAPTCHA. Supported characters: all letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers 2-9 (excludes 0 and 1), and special characters: ```+-/=%"'&_(),.;:?!§`^ÄÖÜßäöüé''‚""„```

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RECAPTCHA_CLASSIC
settings.description: Use classic reCAPTCHA. Set to `no` to use the new Google Cloud-based version.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RECAPTCHA_SITEKEY
settings.description: reCAPTCHA site key. Required for both classic and new versions.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RECAPTCHA_SECRET
settings.description: reCAPTCHA secret key. Required for the classic version only.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RECAPTCHA_PROJECT_ID
settings.description: Google Cloud Project ID. Required for the new version only.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RECAPTCHA_API_KEY
settings.description: Google Cloud API key used to call the reCAPTCHA Enterprise API. Required for the new version only.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RECAPTCHA_JA3
settings.description: Optional JA3 TLS fingerprint to include in Enterprise assessments.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RECAPTCHA_JA4
settings.description: Optional JA4 TLS fingerprint to include in Enterprise assessments.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_RECAPTCHA_SCORE
settings.description: Minimum score required to pass (applies to both classic v3 and the new version).

settings.name: ANTIBOT_HCAPTCHA_SITEKEY
settings.description: **hCaptcha Site Key:** Your hCaptcha site key (get this from hCaptcha).

settings.name: ANTIBOT_HCAPTCHA_SECRET
settings.description: **hCaptcha Secret Key:** Your hCaptcha secret key (get this from hCaptcha).

settings.name: ANTIBOT_TURNSTILE_SITEKEY
settings.description: **Turnstile Site Key:** Your Turnstile site key (get this from Cloudflare).

settings.name: ANTIBOT_TURNSTILE_SECRET
settings.description: **Turnstile Secret Key:** Your Turnstile secret key (get this from Cloudflare).

settings.name: ANTIBOT_MCAPTCHA_SITEKEY
settings.description: **mCaptcha Site Key:** Your mCaptcha site key (get this from mCaptcha).

settings.name: ANTIBOT_MCAPTCHA_SECRET
settings.description: **mCaptcha Secret Key:** Your mCaptcha secret key (get this from mCaptcha).

settings.name: ANTIBOT_MCAPTCHA_URL
settings.description: **mCaptcha Domain:** The domain to use for the mCaptcha challenge.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_CAPJS_FRONTEND_URL
settings.description: **Cap.js Frontend URL:** Browser-facing URL of the Cap.js server that serves the widget.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_CAPJS_BACKEND_URL
settings.description: **Cap.js Backend URL:** Optional internal URL BunkerWeb uses for `/siteverify`; falls back to the frontend URL if empty.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_CAPJS_SITEKEY
settings.description: **Cap.js Sitekey:** The sitekey for the Cap.js challenge.

settings.name: ANTIBOT_CAPJS_SECRET
settings.description: **Cap.js Secret:** The secret key BunkerWeb uses to verify Cap.js tokens.
